messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HOSTED-INFERENCE-PROD 20	4 Service redwood-hosted 20	4 condition: 5xx_rate > 4% over 3m 20	4 urgency: high 20	4 link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/d/hosts/hosted-inference

pd-bot: RID-20260315-2 created 20	4 primary: jamie (on-call) 20	4 secondary: marta 20	4 manager: anika

jamie: ack'd. I'm on it. initial check: spike lines up with recent container image rollout 02:05 UTC (image: runtime:nightly-20260315-02). seeing SIGSEGV in tokenizer process on multiple hosts.

marta: acked via PD at 02:39. grabbing logs and core dumps now. joining call: https://zoom.redwood.internal/j/555111222

lee: I'm watching metrics. error rate peaked to 14% across prod-eu-west and us-east. streaming requests dropped too. not purely traffic-related.

anika: looping in ops. what's customer-level impact? any customers on dedicated nodes?

ops-runner: app teams, heads up: if we need to move traffic, I can reassign VIPs. prefer rollback of image first if possible.

jamie: agree rollback. plan: 1) stop auto-rollout and pause CI pushing runtime images 2) roll image back to runtime:20260314-stable on a small canary 3) temporarily route critical customers to dedicated pools in eu & us

incident-bot: Note: auto-escalation triggered 2ac7 manager (anika) pagered because secondary didn't acknowledge within 90s window

marta: that happened because my phone queued the PD alerts; i acked as soon as i woke. on call now. saw core dump: addresses point to glibc symbol __memcpy_ssse3 and a note about 'built with -march=skylake' 2ad suspect optimized build incompatible with older hosts

lee: cross-checking inventory: ~20% of prod hosts are CML-legacy type without SSSE3; they shouldn't have gotten this image. need to check deployment selector

jamie: pushing rollback to canary:

```bash
opsctl deploy set --service redwood-hosted --image runtime:20260314-stable --hosts hostset-canary-1
```

ops-runner: canary shows immediate reduction in 5xxs. initiating phased rollback. also creating routing rule to move customers X,Y,Z to dedicated-east and dedicated-eu:

`trafficctl route update --match customers_critical --to dedicated-pool --scope multi-region`

pd-bot: PD update: RID-20260315-2 status: acknowledged; secondary marta joined; manager notified. Auto-escalation window closed.

marta: rolling out rollback batch 1 -> 2 -> 3. one host in eu-west failed to transition (kube evict stuck). investigating kubelet logs: 'container runtime failing to restart: overlayfs: invalid argument'

ops-runner: cordoned that node and removed from LB. draining took ~90s. reimaging that host with stable image.

lee: after first two batches error rate dropped from 14% -> 1.1%. latency normalized. streaming reconnects recovered for most clients.

anika: good. please post a short customer update (CS + support) with affected customers and mitigation. keep dedicated routing for 45m.

jamie: posted CS note: "We observed elevated 5xx errors in hosted inference due to an incompatible runtime image. Engineers rolled back the image and rerouted critical traffic; mitigation complete and monitoring ongoing." link: https://support.redwood.internal/tickets/INC-1836

marta: created infra ticket to add CPU-feature gating to the image builder and to enforce node selectors on runtime images: INFRA-4021

ops-runner: routing reverted at 03:24 UTC. verified all critical customers now on standard pools. marking nodes replaced and scheduling maintenance window.

incident-bot: RID-20260315-2 moved to monitoring. incident duration ~45m. postmortem ticket: INC-1836 created: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-1836

anika: assign owners: jamie (rollback & deployment selector), marta (analysis & core dump root cause), lee (metrics & customer-impact), ops-runner (node replacements). please add timeline and who approved the initial image rollout for the postmortem.

jamie: pausing auto-rollout tag in deploy console: `auto-rollouts: disabled` and adding a preflight job to test CPU capability matrix before next rollout.

marta: note for postmortem: PD escalation path triggered 2ac7 consider increasing secondary ack window during high-latency notification windows to avoid manager noise.

ops-runner: will also add an alert to catch image with SSE/AVX instruction flags before it gets scheduled on nodes without capability.

anika: thanks team. once postmortem draft is up, we'll close the thread. nice work.

pd-bot: final: RID-20260315-2 status => resolved (monitoring).
